method: All nine supplied MP4s decoded locally. 'knowable' = visible before the first entry; 'after' = only visible later and never used as causal evidence.

crossEpisodeFindings: Every campaign used Exness Unlimited leverage: 1 lot on 38 USD (V3), 3 lots on 100 USD (V7), 0.05 lot = 169% margin level on 15.66 USD (V5). The money result is leverage x a few points; it is not evidence of a rare edge.
Directional move captured: 5.5-13 points. Size escalated only after floating equity funded it ('until I run out of margin').
First entries were often immediately red (V1 -38, V4 -145, V7 -67): entries are taken at the zone, not after a large confirmation.
Adds are clustered at identical or near-identical prices and sometimes ABOVE the previous fill while the basket is green.
Late large adds near the extended low are the recurring failure (V4, V7 10-lot, V9 20-lot at the prior low).
Exits are equity targets or bulk-close on a pullback, not a structural rule.
Two traders, two vocabularies: kvngjames = fair-value-gap fill + trend continuation; tradingcartel1 = liquidity zone / rejection of highs / break of structure.
8 of 9 campaigns are SELL; BUY evidence is one clip (V8).
Edited promotional clips: losers and pre-entry minutes are not shown, so neither win rate nor frequency can be inferred.
